ffmpeg.spec:
%{!?eval_variant:%global eval_variant S}
%{!?eval_isa:%global eval_isa thumb}
%global eval_common -fdebug-info-for-profiling -funique-internal-linkage-names
%global eval_instrument %{nil}
%if "%{eval_variant}" == "R"
%global eval_instrument -fprofile-generate -mllvm -disable-preinline
%endif
%if "%{eval_variant}" == "C"
%global eval_instrument -fprofile-instr-generate -fcoverage-mapping
%endif
%if "%{eval_variant}" == "G5"
%global eval_instrument -fprofile-generate
%endif
%global eval_arch %{nil}
%if "%{eval_isa}" == "thumb"
%global eval_arch -mthumb
%endif
%if "%{eval_isa}" == "a32"
%global eval_arch -marm
%endif
BuildRequires: compiler-rt
Name:       ffmpeg
Summary:    AV codec lib
Version:    8.0.1
Release: 1.%{eval_isa}%{eval_variant}
Group:      Multimedia/Libraries
URL:        https://ffmpeg.org/
License:    LGPL-2.1+
Source0:    %{name}-%{version}.tar.gz
Source1001:	libavcodec.manifest
Source1002:	libavformat.manifest
Source1003:	libavutil.manifest
Source1004:	libavfilter.manifest
Source1005:	libswscale.manifest
Source1006:	libswresample.manifest
Source1007:	ffmpeg-tool.manifest
%if "%{tizen_profile_name}" == "tv"
%define product_tv 1
%else
%define product_tv 0
%endif
%if ("%{sec_buildconf_multimedia_real_audio_video_supported}" == "1")
%define support_rm 1
%else
%define support_rm 0
%endif
%description
AV codec library


%package -n libavcodec
Summary:    AV codec lib
Group:      Multimedia/Libraries

%description -n libavcodec
AV codec library

%package -n libavcodec-devel
Summary:    AV codec lib (devel)
Group:      Development/Libraries
Requires:   libavcodec = %{version}-%{release}

%description -n libavcodec-devel
AV codec library (devel)

%package -n libavformat
Summary:    AV format lib
Group:      Multimedia/Libraries

%description -n libavformat
AV format library

%package -n libavformat-devel
Summary:    AV format lib (devel)
Group:      Development/Libraries
Requires:   libavformat = %{version}-%{release}

%description -n libavformat-devel
AV format library (devel)

%package -n libavutil
Summary:    AV util lib
Group:      Multimedia/Libraries

%description -n libavutil
AV util library

%package -n libavutil-devel
Summary:    AV util lib (devel)
Group:      Development/Libraries
Requires:   libavutil = %{version}-%{release}

%description -n libavutil-devel
AV util library (devel)

%package -n libavfilter
Summary:    AV util lib
Group:      Multimedia/Libraries

%description -n libavfilter
AV filter library

%package -n libavfilter-devel
Summary:    AV util lib (devel)
Group:      Development/Libraries
Requires:   libavfilter = %{version}-%{release}

%description -n libavfilter-devel
AV filter library (devel)

%package -n libswscale
Summary:    SW scale lib
Group:      Multimedia/Libraries

%description -n libswscale
development files for libswsacle

%package -n libswscale-devel
Summary:    SW scale lib (devel)
Group:      Development/Libraries
Requires:   libswscale = %{version}-%{release}

%description -n libswscale-devel
development files for libswsacle

%package -n libswresample
Summary:    SW resample lib
Group:      Multimedia/Libraries

%description -n libswresample
SW resample library

%package -n libswresample-devel
Summary:    SW resample lib (devel)
Group:      Multimedia/Libraries
Requires:   libswresample = %{version}-%{release}

%description -n libswresample-devel
SW resample library (devel)

%package -n doc
Summary:    Document
Group:      Multimedia/Documentation

%description -n doc
Example files

%package -n ffmpeg-tool
Summary:    FFmpeg Tools
Group:      Development/Tools
Requires:   ffmpeg-tool = %{version}-%{release}

%description -n ffmpeg-tool
FFmpeg Tools

%prep
%setup -q
cp %{SOURCE1001} %{SOURCE1002} %{SOURCE1003} %{SOURCE1004} %{SOURCE1005} %{SOURCE1006} %{SOURCE1007} .

# basic functions
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="--enable-shared \
--disable-static --disable-devices \
--disable-version3 --disable-nonfree --disable-gpl \
--disable-doc --disable-zlib --disable-network \
--disable-programs --enable-ffmpeg \
--disable-avdevice \
--enable-swscale --disable-x86asm --enable-swresample \
--enable-neon --disable-stripping \
%{?asan:--disable-asm} \
"
# parsers
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--disable-parsers \
--enable-parser=aac --enable-parser=h264 --enable-parser=mpegaudio \
--enable-parser=h263 --enable-parser=mpeg4video --enable-parser=mpegvideo \
--enable-parser=hevc \
"
# muxers
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--disable-muxers \
--enable-muxer=mpeg1video --enable-muxer=mpeg2video --enable-muxer=wav \
--enable-muxer=null --enable-muxer=mp4 \
"
# demuxers
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--disable-demuxers \
--enable-demuxer=aac --enable-demuxer=h264 --enable-demuxer=mpegts \
--enable-demuxer=amr --enable-demuxer=m4v --enable-demuxer=mpegtsraw \
--enable-demuxer=asf --enable-demuxer=mmf --enable-demuxer=mpegvideo \
--enable-demuxer=avi --enable-demuxer=mov --enable-demuxer=ogg \
--enable-demuxer=flac --enable-demuxer=mp3 --enable-demuxer=wav \
--enable-demuxer=h263 --enable-demuxer=mpegps --enable-demuxer=matroska \
--enable-demuxer=dv --enable-demuxer=flv \
--enable-demuxer=aiff --enable-demuxer=ape --enable-demuxer=hevc \
--enable-demuxer=concat \
"
%if !0%{?product_tv}
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--enable-demuxer=rm \
"
%else
%if 0%{?support_rm}
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--enable-demuxer=rm \
"
%endif
%endif
# decoders
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--disable-decoders \
--enable-decoder=alac --enable-decoder=h264 --enable-decoder=wmv1 \
--enable-decoder=flac --enable-decoder=mpeg4 --enable-decoder=wmv2 \
--enable-decoder=h263 --enable-decoder=mpegvideo --enable-decoder=wmv3 \
--enable-decoder=vc1 --enable-decoder=flv \
--enable-decoder=h263i --enable-decoder=theora --enable-decoder=mpeg1video \
--enable-decoder=mpeg2video --enable-decoder=pcm_alaw --enable-decoder=pcm_mulaw \
--enable-decoder=msmpeg4v3 --enable-decoder=hevc --enable-decoder=mjpeg \
--enable-decoder=bmp --enable-decoder=tiff --enable-decoder=mp3 \
--enable-decoder=amrnb --enable-decoder=ac3 --enable-decoder=aac \
--enable-decoder=ape --enable-decoder=pcm_s16le \
"
%if !0%{?product_tv}
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--enable-decoder=rv40 \
"
%else
%if 0%{?support_rm}
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--enable-decoder=rv40 \
"
%endif
%endif
# encoders
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--disable-encoders \
--enable-encoder=h263 --enable-encoder=h263p --enable-encoder=mpeg4 \
--enable-encoder=bmp --enable-encoder=mpeg1video --enable-encoder=mpeg2video \
--enable-encoder=aac --enable-encoder=wrapped_avframe --enable-encoder=pcm_s16le \
"
# protocols
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--disable-protocols --enable-protocol=file "

# filters
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--disable-filters \
--enable-filter=crop --enable-filter=hflip --enable-filter=lut \
--enable-filter=lutyuv --enable-filter=lutrgb --enable-filter=overlay \
--enable-filter=scale --enable-filter=transpose --enable-filter=unsharp \
--enable-filter=vflip --enable-filter=zoompan --enable-filter=scdet \
--enable-filter=blackdetect --enable-filter=silencedetect --enable-filter=aresample \
"

# bitstream filters
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--disable-bsfs --enable-bsf=h264_mp4toannexb "

export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--toolchain=hardened --enable-parser=vp8 --enable-decoder=vp8 --enable-decoder=vp9 "

%ifarch %{arm} aarch64
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--disable-mmx "
%else
%endif

CFLAGS="%{optflags} -fPIC -DEXPORT_API=\"__attribute__((visibility(\\\"default\\\")))\" "; export CFLAGS
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -D__TIZEN__ -DTIZEN_FEATURE_LIBAV %{eval_common} %{eval_arch} %{eval_instrument}"
%if "%{eval_isa}" == "a32"
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS --disable-thumb "
%endif
%if "%{eval_isa}" == "thumb"
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS --enable-thumb "
%endif

%ifarch %{arm}
export CONFIGURE_OPTIONS="$CONFIGURE_OPTIONS--extra-cflags=-mfpu=neon"
%endif

export AR=%{__ar} RANLIB=%{__ranlib}
export CC=%{__cc} CXX=%{__cxx}

./configure \
    --prefix=%{_prefix} \
    --libdir=%{_libdir} \
    --shlibdir=%{_libdir} \
    --datadir=%{_datadir}/%{name} \
    --extra-ldflags="-Wl,--build-id=sha1 %{eval_instrument}" \
    $CONFIGURE_OPTIONS

%build


clang --version
rpm --eval '%{optflags}'
%__make V=1 %{?_smp_mflags}

%install
rm -rf %{buildroot}
%make_install

%post -p /sbin/ldconfig
%postun -p /sbin/ldconfig

%files -n libavcodec
%manifest libavcodec.manifest
%defattr(-,root,root,-)
%{_libdir}/libavcodec.so.*
%license COPYING.LGPLv2.1
%post -n libavcodec -p /sbin/ldconfig
%postun -n libavcodec -p /sbin/ldconfig

%files -n libavformat
%manifest libavformat.manifest
%defattr(-,root,root,-)
%{_libdir}/libavformat.so.*
%license COPYING.LGPLv2.1
%post -n libavformat -p /sbin/ldconfig
%postun -n libavformat -p /sbin/ldconfig

%files -n libavutil
%manifest libavutil.manifest
%defattr(-,root,root,-)
%{_libdir}/libavutil.so.*
%license COPYING.LGPLv2.1
%post -n libavutil -p /sbin/ldconfig
%postun -n libavutil -p /sbin/ldconfig

%files -n libavfilter

%defattr(-,root,root,-)

%license COPYING.LGPLv2.1

%files -n libswscale
